fused accusative singular phalam with indeclinable evam
present active third singular of pra-yam

items.question: Does the practice grant the same fruit even when undertaken from ignorance?
items.inference: Even an ignorant performance yields the stated fruit.
uncertainties: The exact fruit is not specified by the verse.
items.plain_english: Even from ignorance, O goddess, it grants such fruit.
